item.title: Operando X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy Reveals Oxide Solid Electrolyte Stability against Electrochemically Plated Lithium
item.description:
با operando XPS مبتنی بر آزمایشگاه، پایداری الکترولیت‌های جامد اکسیدی در برابر لیتیم آبکاری‌شده الکتروشیمیایی بررسی شد؛ LATP کاهش یافته و فاز واسط Li+/Ti3+ تشکیل می‌دهد، اما LLZO کاهش Zr یا La نشان نمی‌دهد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 First operando XPS study of oxide solid electrolyte stability against electrochemically plated Li, avoiding artifacts of non-electrochemical deposition. Reveals LATP reduces to a Li+/Ti3+-rich mixed-conducting interphase that partially relaxes, while LLZO shows no resolvable Zr/La reduction—clarifying intrinsic interfacial reactivity and guiding stable solid-state battery design.
🏷 solid electrolyte · operando XPS · lithium plating · LATP · LLZO

item.title: Cascade Catalysis of Zn/Nb Single‐Atom Sites for Wide‐Temperature Li‐S Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a cascade catalysis strategy using dual Zn-N4 and Nb-N4 single-atom sites on N,P co-doped carbon fibers, where Nb adsorbs and converts LiPSs while Zn drives subsequent Li2S conversion. This enables fast sulfur redox and suppressed shuttling, delivering excellent wide-temperature Li-S performance (651.8 mAh g−1 at 50°C, 401.1 mAh g−1 at −20°C after 500 cycles), guiding multistep kinetics design.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · single-atom catalyst · cascade catalysis · polysulfide shuttling · wide-temperature

💡 The novelty lies in a multiscale separator design that translates lattice-level negative thermal expansion of Cu₂P₂O₇ into macroscopic thermomechanical self-compensation via PDA-mediated interfacial coupling with PVDF-HFP. This suppresses separator deformation and HF corrosion, enabling dimensional stability to 200°C, 3000 h cycling, and 1000 stable cycles at 5 C—offering a solid-state strategy to mitigate thermomechanical failure in high-power lithium metal batteries.

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work first identifies Na⁺ and K⁺ as dominant charge carriers in cement-based structural capacitors using unidirectional charging, then designs a Zn-based tracer capacitor to reveal field-assisted ion diffusion pathways through the porous cement network. It further clarifies governing factors—carrier concentration, water content, and the percolating 3D micro/nanoporous network—providing fundamental insights for rational CSC design.

National Science Review | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a dual-interface strategy combining a catalytic-shielded carbon coating with confined spinel domains, decoupling electrolyte decomposition from lattice catalysis while enabling 3D Li+ transport and strain buffering. Significance: 93.1% ICE, 295 mAh g−1, 88.9% retention over 150 cycles at 4.99 V, and a 307 Wh kg−1 pouch cell demonstrate practical high-voltage LRO viability.
